releases.title: Everyday design flow, richer import and a redo fix
notes: Clicking now reaches objects on a page-level frame, as on an artboard. Its empty area and name still select the frame.
Option-drag copies layers, dragging moves layers in and out of frames, X and Y are relative to the parent, and copy and paste properties and alignment keys are in. Undo keeps your selection.

Text types where it will land, Shift-A reads direction and gap from what you drew, and the inspector is about half as tall, with the color picker folded to one row. The native Mac menus now use the same tidy order as the in-app menus.
Fixes a redone edit being lost if the app reloaded or quit within about a second of Redo, and the code layer preview failing on older macOS.

SVG, Sketch, PDF and .fig import keep much more live structure, vector networks gain faces and holes, and strokes run on curves and closed contours. PDF pages open as editable shapes, images and text.
Guest scripts run in a worker, so a runaway plugin or code layer can be stopped instead of freezing Forma. A guest canvas cannot read itself synchronously or draw an image element.
limits: This is a development preview. Exact installer metadata and checksums are published on the Forma website after release validation.
Forma is an offline Mac app. Multiplayer, accounts, hosted publishing and AI generation are not included.
Catalog fonts that are not bundled, cached or installed still download from Google Fonts when requested, which the Privacy dashboard discloses.
.fig and Sketch import are tested on self-authored fixtures only, not on files from those apps.
VoiceOver, physical trackpad, printer and tablet acceptance, Intel hardware, older macOS, and real PowerPoint and Figma round trips remain open.
Complete Figma parity and binary .fig export remain unfinished.

releases.title: Mac fixes, real video export and prototype comments
notes: Fixes for the Mac app: every file picker now opens, PowerPoint, Markdown, palette and code exports save, full screen works in Slides and prototypes, and restarting from safe mode keeps your file.
Export MP4 and WebM frame by frame with sound, using H.264, VP9, AAC and Opus. Exported WebM now plays in WebKit, and shaders animate in preview and export.
Comment on running prototypes, annotate and measure on the canvas, and resize groups so their layers keep real sizes.
Convert a file between sRGB and Display P3 with appearance preserved, generate SwiftUI and Compose code, use layout-aware shortcuts and scale the interface to 150%.
Paste text, images and SVG from other apps, drop files from Finder, and sample screen colors from the Edit menu. Native acceptance now runs 85 checks in the real app.

releases.title: Components, drawing, branches and offline resources
notes: Build real design systems: nested instance overrides and exposed nested properties, published and linked variables, variable groups, usage counts and local branches with three-way merge.
Draw and type with more control: stretch brushes, an illustration toolbar, straight knife, shape eraser, curved corner rounding, keyboard lists, real variable font axes and the full emoji catalog.

Lay out and present: automatic group bounds, nested baselines, drag reorder in auto layout, nested scroll regions, device shells, Smart animate improvements and exact vector angular and diamond paints.

New workspaces and tools: Sites with static export, brand asset templates, shader paints and Display P3, runnable code layers, sandboxed widgets, PowerPoint interchange, design health audits, UI kits and tutorials.
Mac and reliability: native tabs, print, system share, document versions, crash journal, persisted Undo, safe mode, renderer restart, Romanian interface and an accessibility sweep.

releases.title: Canvas overview, text search and frame delivery
notes: Navigate with optional accessible canvas scrollbars and a schematic minimap. Camera gestures can be canceled without changing artwork.
Find literal text across pages, selected layer trees and slides; replace editable matches with preserved rich formatting, Undo and saved-file validation.
Inspect frame overflow in a read-only preview, create a prototype starting point from the selected frame, and save frame export profiles for SVG, PNG and JPEG.
limits: This is a development preview. Exact installer metadata and checksums are published on the Forma website after release validation.
Minimap bounds are schematic; masks, stroke/effect expansion and exact rotated clipping are not reproduced.
Text search operates on bounded literal base text; language-specific word breaking and motion-keyframe replacement are unfinished.
Frame overflow bounds are conservative, and advanced/batch/PDF frame export profiles remain unfinished.
Complete Figma parity, binary .fig export and cloud collaboration remain unfinished.

releases.title: Canvas navigation and frame workflows
notes: Move Back and Forward through bounded camera history with Option-Command-Left/Right. Finding a selection centers its current animated position without changing artwork.
Control existing top-level frame and section names independently with persistent View settings.
Insert searchable Watch, Paper and Presentation frame presets from Assets.
Swap a frame orientation, select its visible unlocked direct children, or fit a supported free-layout frame while keeping child artwork in place. Undo and saved files retain supported frame edits.
Refuse overflowing frame-fit geometry before changing the document.
limits: This is a development preview. Current installer metadata and checksums are published on the Forma website.
Name toggles cover existing top-level labels. Nested container labels remain unfinished.
Fit uses direct child rectangular bounds without stroke/effect padding and refuses managed, motion, generated and auto-layout contexts.
Substantial Figma parity remains unfinished, including binary .fig export and cloud collaboration.

releases.title: Offline Figma Design import
notes: Open supported local binary .fig Design files in the browser or Mac app, without uploading the source file.
Preserve supported page/layer geometry, embedded images and original glyph shapes while keeping text editable. Review any feature reductions after import.
Import component instances as detached editable layers. Native annotation blocks can retain their own embedded visual snapshots.
Imported Mac files start as new unsaved projects. Save a .oui copy; the Figma source is never a save destination.
Cancel obsolete imports before they can replace current edits or the active recovery identity.
limits: This is a development preview. Current installer metadata and checksums are published on the Forma website.
Binary .fig import supports a documented subset of Design files. Live component linkage, native rich annotation editing, complete prototype/layout semantics and full visual parity are not promised.
Binary .fig export and substantial Figma suite parity remain unfinished.

releases.title: Pages, local layouts and image clipboard
notes: Duplicate, reorder and search pages with contextual and keyboard actions; shared component links stay intact and unsafe deletion is refused.
Remember each Design/Whiteboard page's pan and zoom locally, and preview its static artwork on hover or keyboard focus.
Paste bounded PNG/TIFF image data into the Mac canvas, including the active slide. Copy as PNG creates a transparent 2× selection snapshot.
Follow system light/dark appearance, or retain an explicit interface theme.
Saved-file MCP adds atomic page duplication and reordering. Browser startup waits for recovery before editing or autosave.
Move supported complete layer trees between pages with stable identities and live component links; unsafe contextual cases are refused.
Add a plain-text project description through File information, with Undo and saved-file MCP metadata reads.
Collapse and resize layers/properties sidebars with pointer or keyboard controls; local layout stays outside project files.
Browse bundled release notes from Help, with development/preview labels and public download checksums.
Open registered local file actions from the document-title menu, with keyboard navigation and focus return.
Follow system reduced-motion preferences for editor chrome, with a local override; deliberate authored animation and exports retain their settings.
Identify mask sources, modes and nearest affected artwork in the layer tree with bounded accessible descriptions.
limits: This is a development preview with documented limits. Current installer metadata and checksums are published on the Forma website.
Browser/Windows system-image clipboard and private Figma editable clipboard remain unfinished.
Substantial Figma suite parity remains unfinished, including binary .fig interchange and cloud collaboration.

releases.title: Native editable clipboard and canvas backgrounds
notes: Transfer editable Forma layers between Mac document windows, with validated component/style/variable/font dependencies and one-step Undo.
Edit page canvas color, opacity and visibility; use an explicit color-pair contrast checker.
Use the local vector, typography, layout, components, variables, prototype, whiteboard, Slides and motion workspaces.
limits: This Mac preview is earlier than the current development source and has documented feature limits.
The app and DMG were Developer ID signed, notarized, stapled and Gatekeeper checked. The universal binary includes Intel; Intel runtime validation is pending.
Keep .oui projects and backups when upgrading. There is no silent updater.
